questions.text: How much weight have you lost and over what time period? Is the weight loss intentional (through diet or exercise) or unintentional?
questions.purpose: Distinguish intentional from unintentional weight loss; clinically significant unintentional loss is >5% body weight in 3 months
options: Unintentional — less than 3 kg in 3 months
Unintentional — more than 5 kg in 3 months
Unintentional — more than 10% body weight in 6 months

questions.text: Have you also had fever, night sweats, or new lumps or swellings?
questions.purpose: B-symptoms alongside weight loss strongly suggest malignancy or serious systemic illness

questions.text: Have you had a change in bowel habits, rectal bleeding, or abdominal pain?
questions.purpose: GI symptoms with weight loss require colorectal malignancy and GI disorder workup

questions.text: Are you experiencing increased thirst, frequent urination, or blurred vision?
questions.purpose: Weight loss with polydipsia and polyuria suggests undiagnosed or uncontrolled diabetes mellitus

questions.text: Are you experiencing palpitations, heat intolerance, tremor, or anxiety alongside weight loss?
questions.purpose: Hyperthyroidism causes weight loss despite preserved appetite; thyroid function tests are needed

questions.text: Have you had any low mood, reduced appetite, or loss of interest in food related to psychological causes?
questions.purpose: Depression, anxiety, and eating disorders are common psychological causes of weight loss
